WITH order_values AS (
  SELECT
    o.orderid,
    (COALESCE(o.comments, '') ~* '(promo|discount|coupon|voucher|special offer)'
     OR COALESCE(o.internalcomments, '') ~* '(promo|discount|coupon|voucher|special offer)'
     OR COALESCE(o.deliveryinstructions, '') ~* '(promo|discount|coupon|voucher|special offer)') AS has_promotion,
    SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unitprice) AS order_value
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orders o
  JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines ol ON ol.orderid = o.orderid
  WHERE CAST(o.orderdate AS DATE) = DATE '2024-11-29'
  GROUP BY o.orderid, 2
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_promotion) AS orders_with_promotion,
  AVG(order_value) FILTER (WHERE has_promotion) AS avg_order_value_with_promotion,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_promotion) AS orders_without_promotion,
  AVG(order_value) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_promotion) AS avg_order_value_without_promotion
FROM order_values
LIMIT 500
